name: GameStop Military Discount
description: 10% off toys, collectibles, and pre-owned items in-store for military
fullDescription: GameStop offers military personnel and law enforcement 10% off in-store purchases of toys, collectibles, and pre-owned items year-round.
whatTheyOffer:
- 10% off toys and collectibles
- 10% off pre-owned games and items
- In-store only (not valid online)
- Excludes new video game hardware, digital currency, gift cards, and sale or clearance items
- Year-round discount
howToGetIt:
1. Visit any GameStop store
2. Present valid military ID, DD-214, or verify status through an online verification platform
3. Discount applied to eligible purchases at checkout
keywords: GameStop, military discount, veteran, law enforcement, 10% off, video games, pre-owned, collectibles, toys
